qualification: Require explicit guest RAM translation for virtio

assertions: Unbound GPA translation and nonempty copies fail
Unbound queue activation fails without changing GPA registers
Bounded translator enables queue activation and copies
Clearing the translator disables subsequent translation and copies

tests.scope: Host suite, ARM64/x86_64 backend compilation, both root-task boots, AArch64 guest net/block/bidirectional console proofs

limitations: Unconfigured-translator rejection is a host test, not an on-target isolation qualification.
Clearing the hook does not revoke cached ring aliases or guest RAM capabilities; teardown must quiesce devices and reset rings separately.
Intel guest-device integration and lifecycle remain incomplete.
